song: 50 - Hermanos Rosario - En el fin de semana
title: scratch card for the merengue break
story: Merengue at 152 BPM (tracker beat 12.64 ticks). The guira strokes glint the scratch heads and the tambora slaps flash the ragged edge with a zoom; the scratch direction turns every two beats. The break (7338-7539) brightens and the passes swell phrase by phrase with the accordion and sax riff; the palette sways per bar. The triple 7659/7665/7672 changes three floats on each hit, and the last hit is the biggest. After the break the drums return and the pattern carries on.
